hero.title: The nine students who lead Y-AID
hero.text: Five board members run the club: its registration, funding, outreach and the division of design teams. Four project managers lead the teams and stay in touch with each device's recipient.
hero.imageAlt: Y-AID members standing together at a buildathon

boardIntro.title: The board
boardIntro.text: The board keeps contact with SEAS, the CEID and our faculty advisor, assigns projects and runs the annual buildathon.

managersIntro.title: The project managers
managersIntro.text: Each manager takes charge of projects assigned by the vice presidents and works directly with recipients on what they want and need.

advisor.name: Daniel Wiznia, MD
advisor.text: An orthopaedic surgeon at the Yale School of Medicine, Dr. Wiznia gives the club medical expertise and guidance from his clinical experience.

close.title: Every leader here started on a project team.
